findings.body: The test claims to assert the wire between config and gateway, but it constructs `GatewayModel` manually and only calls the free function `reasoning_options` on the field. It never invokes `harness()` or checks what `with_default_provider_options` receives, so a regression where `harness` stops forwarding `reasoning_effort` would pass this test. The positive case should exercise the actual `harness` builder and inspect the provider options it produces, or the request payload via a mock.
findings.title: Make the gateway integration test call harness, not reasoning_options directly

value.summary: The pricing and model-selection changes are well covered by tests that pin actual costs and ensure defaults have prices, but the new integration test for reasoning_effort doesn't actually exercise the gateway wiring, leaving a stated contract untested.
